content: {"like":["Enjoys emotionally driven, hopeful narratives in literary adaptations like Stephen King.","Values supernatural thrillers that focus on atmosphere over gore, such as ghost stories.","Appreciates strong dual-character performances in suspenseful dramas.","Supports female‑led superhero series with engaging storylines and charismatic leads.","Finds classic adventure mini‑series entertaining when produced by Hallmark."],"dislike":["Dislikes horror that relies on gore or graphic violence.","Rejects films that feel disjointed or suffer from unnecessary added scenes.","Criticizes low‑budget productions with unrealistic sets and poor soundtracks.","Opposes narratives that feel like cash‑in on paranormal trends.","Dislikes franchise launches that start poorly or include absurd plot twists."]}
